result.title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rollout refresh, the shared policy generates both a privileged Teacher trajectory and a problem-only Student trajectory. A pairwise preference objective uses privileged Teacher trajectories to improve Student learning, while the reversed preference uses the Student's behavior to shape future Teacher supervision under the privileged condition. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show that TeachBack consistently improves Student performance over existing OPSD methods and related baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 on-policy 自蒸馏中学生从带有特权信息（参考解）的 Teacher 轨迹中学习的问题，提出 TeachBack 双向偏好优化框架：通过控制注入提示的参考推理后缀长度与提示风格来塑造 Teacher 的生成行为，使其减少对参考解的依赖、重新探索与自我验证，并用正向与反向偏好目标同时改进 Student 学习和未来 Teacher 监督。数学与逻辑推理实验中 Student 性能优于现有 OPSD 与相关基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本设定，但其「特权信息导致轨迹虽准确却不适合学生、诱发走捷径的推导」这一诊断，与 VLM 中把视觉证据或参考解作为特权信息做蒸馏、担心视觉旁路与轨迹监督贡献分配的问题可能直接对应，可供核查其教师行为塑造与双向偏好监督能否迁移到 LVR 轨迹训练。
